verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.pt: Então respondeu Zofar, o naamatita, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,
verses.en_bbe: Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

verses.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.pt: Não se dará resposta à multidão de palavras? ou será justificado o homem falador?
verses.en_web: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.en_bbe: Are all these words to go unanswered? and is a man seen to be right because he is full of talk?

verses.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.pt: Acaso as tuas jactâncias farão calar os homens? e zombarás tu sem que ninguém te envergonhe?
verses.en_web: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, shall no man make you ashamed?
verses.en_bbe: Are your words of pride to make men keep quiet? and are you to make sport, with no one to put you to shame?

verses.en: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.pt: Pois dizes: A minha doutrina é pura, e limpo sou aos teus olhos.
verses.en_web: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’
verses.en_bbe: You may say, My way is clean, and I am free from sin in your eyes.

verses.en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
verses.pt: Mas, na verdade, oxalá que Deus falasse e abrisse os seus lábios contra ti,
verses.en_web: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,
verses.en_bbe: But if only God would take up the word, opening his lips in argument with you;

verses.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
verses.pt: e te fizesse saber os segredos da sabedoria, pois é multiforme o seu entendimento; sabe, pois, que Deus exige de ti menos do que merece a tua iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.
verses.en_bbe: And would make clear to you the secrets of wisdom, and the wonders of his purpose!

verses.en: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.pt: Poderás descobrir as coisas profundas de Deus, ou descobrir perfeitamente o Todo-Poderoso?
verses.en_web: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
verses.en_bbe: Are you able to take God's measure, to make discovery of the limits of the Ruler of all?

verses.en: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
verses.pt: Como as alturas do céu é a sua sabedoria; que poderás tu fazer? Mais profunda é ela do que o Seol; que poderás tu saber?
verses.en_web: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?
verses.en_bbe: They are higher than heaven; what is there for you to do? deeper than the underworld, and outside your knowledge;

verses.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.pt: Mais comprida é a sua medida do que a terra, e mais larga do que o mar.
verses.en_web: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.en_bbe: Longer in measure than the earth, and wider than the sea.

verses.en: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.pt: Se ele passar e prender alguém, e chamar a juízo, quem o poderá impedir?
verses.en_web: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?
verses.en_bbe: If he goes on his way, shutting a man up and putting him to death, who may make him go back from his purpose?

verses.en: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
verses.pt: Pois ele conhece os homens vãos; e quando vê a iniqüidade, não atentará para ela?
verses.en_web: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
verses.en_bbe: For in his eyes men are as nothing; he sees evil and takes note of it.

verses.en: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.
verses.pt: Mas o homem vão adquirirá entendimento, quando a cria do asno montês nascer homem.
verses.en_web: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
verses.en_bbe: And so a hollow-minded man will get wisdom, when a young ass of the field gets teaching.

verses.en: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
verses.pt: Se tu preparares o teu coração, e estenderes as mãos para ele;
verses.en_web: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
verses.en_bbe: But if you put your heart right, stretching out your hands to him;

verses.en: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
verses.pt: se há iniqüidade na tua mão, lança-a para longe de ti, e não deixes a perversidade habitar nas tuas tendas;
verses.en_web: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
verses.en_bbe: If you put far away the evil of your hands, and let no wrongdoing have a place in your tent;

verses.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.pt: então levantarás o teu rosto sem mácula, e estarás firme, e não temerás.
verses.en_web: Surely then you shall lift up your face without spot; Yes, you shall be steadfast, and shall not fear:
verses.en_bbe: Then truly your face will be lifted up, with no mark of sin, and you will be fixed in your place without fear:

verses.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
verses.pt: Pois tu te esquecerás da tua miséria; apenas te lembrarás dela como das águas que já passaram.
verses.en_web: for you shall forget your misery. You shall remember it like waters that have passed away.
verses.en_bbe: For your sorrow will go from your memory, like waters flowing away:

verses.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
verses.pt: E a tua vida será mais clara do que o meio-dia; a escuridão dela será como a alva.
verses.en_web: Life shall be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it shall be as the morning.
verses.en_bbe: And your life will be brighter than day; though it is dark, it will become like the morning.

verses.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.pt: E terás confiança, porque haverá esperança; olharás ao redor de ti e repousarás seguro.
verses.en_web: You shall be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you shall search, and shall take your rest in safety.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be safe because there is hope; after looking round, you will take your rest in quiet;

verses.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.pt: Deitar-te-ás, e ninguém te amedrontará; muitos procurarão obter o teu favor.
verses.en_web: Also you shall lie down, and no one shall make you afraid. Yes, many shall court your favor.
verses.en_bbe: Sleeping with no fear of danger; and men will be desiring to have grace in your eyes;

verses.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
verses.pt: Mas os olhos dos ímpios desfalecerão, e para eles não haverá refúgio; a sua esperança será o expirar.
verses.en_web: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail. They shall have no way to flee. Their hope shall be the giving up of the spirit.”
verses.en_bbe: But the eyes of the evil-doers will be wasting away; their way of flight is gone, and their only hope is the taking of their last breath.
